result.brief: 提出 U-JiT：类 UNet 的 Transformer 像素空间视频生成架构，改进训练与采样策略，在 Kinetics-600 上超越潜空间与像素空间基线，并分析时空压缩率的影响。
result.reason: Pixel-space video generation with UNet-like transformer, directly comparing against latent/autoencoder approaches and analyzing compression trade-offs for video generative modeling.
